kultivator.dimensi.bawah.source: Source: Journey to the West ch. 3: Sun Wukong is dragged to the underworld and strikes his name from the Book of Life and Death; ch. 10-11: Emperor Taizong's soul goes down, is judged by the Yama Kings with Judge Cui Jue and returns to life; Liaozhai Zhiyi, 'Xi Fangping': Xi Fangping's soul descends to demand justice for his father; Yuli Baochao (the Jade Record): the ten courts of the underworld, the Naihe bridge and Meng Po's soup that erases the memory of past lives. Inspired by the Netherworld of Coiling Dragon. The soul journey, the trials and their numbers are game design.
kultivator.dimensi.laut.source: Source: Liezi ch. 5 (Tang Wen): the five immortal island-mountains, Daiyu, Yuanjiao, Fanghu, Yingzhou and Penglai, float in the eastern sea, held up by fifteen giant turtles until a giant of the Longbo land hooks six of them; Journey to the West ch. 3: Sun Wukong visits the Dragon Palace of the Eastern Sea and receives the Ruyi Jingu staff from the Dragon King Ao Guang; Fengshen Yanyi ch. 12: Nezha kills the yaksha Li Gen sent by the Dragon King. Inspired by the Chaotic Star Sea of A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality. The islands, the monsters and their numbers are game design.
kultivator.dimensi.court.source: Source: Yuli Baochao (the Jade Record): the ten kings of the underworld courts, from King Qinguang to King Zhuanlun, and the Mirror of Retribution (Niejing Tai) at the first court; Journey to the West ch. 10-11: Emperor Taizong's soul stands before the Yama Kings with Judge Cui Jue; Ox-Head and Horse-Face, the underworld's guards in folk belief. The trial of each court is game design.
kultivator.dimensi.buku.source: Source: Journey to the West ch. 3: in the Senluo Palace Sun Wukong seizes the Book of Life and Death and strikes out his name and the names of all monkeys; ch. 11: Judge Cui Jue changes Emperor Taizong's span of years in that book. The rewards and Strike Your Name are game design.
kultivator.dimensi.arwah.source: Source: the Ullambana Sutra (Yulanpen Jing): Mulian saves his mother, reborn as a hungry ghost; Liaozhai Zhiyi: ghosts who send word to the living. The letters and escorts are game design.
kultivator.dimensi.raja_naga.source: Source: Journey to the West ch. 3: Sun Wukong visits the Crystal Palace of the Eastern Sea and obtains the Ruyi Jingu staff from the Dragon King Ao Guang; Fengshen Yanyi ch. 12: the yaksha Li Gen, the Dragon King's envoy, is slain by Nezha. The quests and the pearl's price are game design.
kultivator.dimensi.penglai.source: Source: Liezi ch. 5 (Tang Wen): Penglai, one of the immortal island-mountains of the eastern sea, where immortals dwell; Shiji, the Basic Annals of the First Emperor of Qin: Xu Fu is sent to sail for Penglai and the elixir of immortality. The immortal's trial and the Spring Water are game design.

kultivator.screen.help.dunia_bawah.title: The Underworld
kultivator.screen.help.dunia_bawah: From Nascent Soul on your soul may leave its body. Find a Ghost Gate Shrine in a swamp, dark forest or pale garden (/kultivasi peta, or a teahouse rumour). At night, hold a Soul Incense (1 Soul Nurturing Wood + 2 Mid Spirit Stones, or the black market) and sneak for 3 s at the altar; during a Blood Eclipse no incense is needed. Your body stays behind as a mannequin that cannot be harmed (a touch on it pulls you home) and your soul arrives on the Wangxiang Terrace for 20 minutes: no hunger, a pale edge on your view and a timer. The Huangquan road of red spider lilies leads to the Naihe bridge; at its end Meng Po offers her soup (once every 7 days): forget your Dao path (half the comprehension is stored), wash away Heart Demons and Qi Deviation, or forget the selected technique. Refusing the soup opens the Ten Courts, taken in order: the Mirror of Retribution shows your real deeds, the Ox-Head and Horse-Face guards duel you (stops at 10%% health), a judge asks a riddle, and a lost soul begs to be led to the bridge. Every court gives Soul Jade. Then King Yama opens the Book of Life and Death: below True Immortal you receive a Soul Lantern and provisions; a True Immortal may once Strike Your Name (+5%% max health, permanent). In the Ghost Villages, ghosts entrust letters for the living or ask to be escorted; Hungry Ghosts and yaksha patrols roam. A deadly blow as a soul never kills: you wake in your body at 1 HP with a 10-minute Soul Wound and lose nothing. Leaving the game as a soul means waking in your body. No block is changed: shrines and palaces appear only when new chunks are made. On the Wangxiang Terrace, Bai Wuchang and Hei Wuchang greet the souls: talk to them to see your soul time, the progress of your journey and the way to your next place. The soup that forgets a technique gives its mastery back as insight (+1 comprehension per 50 points, at most +4). A court passed for the first time also pays Stone Value (9 x its number, doubled at courts 5 and 10); court 5 adds a Soul Incense for the way home, court 10 two Soul Nurturing Wood. The Mirror of Retribution also reads your deeds in the wide world and your Mode Kehancuran. The people below greet you by your realm and bow to a True Immortal; hungry ghosts do not hunt a True Immortal unless struck. During a Blood Eclipse above, the hungry dead gather half again as thick. Ghost Gate Shrines in swamps are built of mangrove; in dark forests some are pagodas.
kultivator.screen.help.laut_tanpa_batas: The endless eastern sea, 60 blocks deep, where spirit islands float (Liezi). From Golden Core on: swim into a Sea Gate on a deep-ocean floor while holding a Sea-Guiding Pearl (crafted: a nautilus shell, 2 prismarine crystals, 1 Mid Spirit Stone; or the black market). Use the pearl to point to the nearest gate. A sect ship can also sail to this sea. You arrive at the Arrival Harbour; the Way Home gate on the harbour and on every island returns you to where you came from. Herb Isles give one aged herb per bed per day, Hermit Isles one lesson, Market Isles hold merchants and a teahouse, Reef Isles are guarded by rock crabs and yaksha. Penyu Ao swims by with a little island on its back: you can stand on it. The Dragon Palace on the sea floor (Deity Transformation+): Ao Guang the Dragon King sells Dragon Pearls and gives two quests; after the first, his gate guard gives you the Water-Parting Pearl (breathe in this sea's water). The rare Penglai Isle holds the immortal's trial (Dao Union+): win the duel of insight for the Penglai Spring Water (+20 comprehension, once). Sea monsters grow stronger every 1,000 blocks from the centre (Golden Core to Immortal Ascension), never within 160 blocks of the harbour. Islands and palaces appear only in new chunks; no block is changed. Every kind of island has two forms (a walled herb garden, a hermit's crag, a harbour market, a reef atoll). The old fisherman on the Arrival Harbour and on the fishing jetties around the islands tells you where the nearest island of the kind you choose lies, or the Dragon Palace, Penglai or Penyu Ao, and marks it on your map (once every 30 seconds). The Dragon King also opens his armoury of sea-forged water artifacts (Heaven grade 770 SV; Immortal grade 2,640 SV for an honoured guest who finished both his errands). During the Twin Moons above, the spirit tide rises and every herb bed gives two herbs. Set foot on all four kinds of spirit isle for an achievement.
kultivator.dimensi.gelar.raja_naga: Dragon King of the Eastern Sea
kultivator.dimensi.wuchang.source: Source: Chinese folk belief in Heibai Wuchang (Xie Bi'an and Fan Wujiu), two envoys of the underworld who fetch the souls of the dead; their tall hats read 'Yi jian sheng cai' (one look brings fortune) and 'Tianxia taiping' (peace under heaven). Their role on Teras Wangxiang is game design.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.meng_po.g0: The soup is not bitter; memory is.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.meng_po.g1: A thousand years I have stirred this pot, and nobody asks for more.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.meng_po.g2: The Naihe bridge is narrow; those who carry grudges often slip.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.meng_po.g3: Forgetting is a gift. You are just not ready to receive it.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.meng_po.r0: A young soul... yours has only just learned to walk alone.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.meng_po.r1: A soul this strong rarely passes. You might need two bowls.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.meng_po.r2: A True Immortal in my kitchen? Sit. Today I let the soup go cold.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.meng_po.e: A blood moon above: the gates stand open, the queue on the bridge grows long.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.hakim.g0: Every deed is written. My brush never dries.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.hakim.g1: The mirror does not lie; only those who look into it do.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.hakim.g2: The next court weighs heavier. Do not hurry.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.hakim.g3: Judge Cui once lengthened an emperor's life with one stroke. I am more careful.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.hakim.r0: Your record is still thin. Many empty pages to fill.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.hakim.r1: Your book is thick, cultivator. Some of it to be proud of, some not.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.hakim.r2: The name of a True Immortal... my ink trembles to write it.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.hakim.e: A blood eclipse: twice the souls pass today. My ledger is full.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.yama.g0: Life and death are written in one book. I am only its keeper.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.yama.g1: Many come to bargain for years. None bring enough.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.yama.g2: Sun Wukong struck out his name here. Since then I guard the ink myself.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.yama.g3: The ten courts are not punishment, only a longer mirror.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.yama.r0: You are far from the end. Do not hurry to my palace.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.yama.r1: Your soul weighs heavy on the scales. The book awaits your page.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.yama.r2: A True Immortal... few stand before me without fear. You are one.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.yama.e: A bleeding sky opens the gates. The hungry dead slip in too; watch your step.
Lost soul, keep to the lantern road.
My fork has dragged many stubborn souls. Want to be next?
Horse-Face says I am too soft. He never served at the fifth court.
Only the summoned pass here. Were you summoned?
Little soul, your road is long. Do not challenge us.
You are strong. If the judge allows it, I would duel you.
(bows) We keep the road for the Immortal.
An eclipse: more hungry ghosts than usual. My fork is ready.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.arwah.g0: I still remember the smell of rice at home...
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.arwah.g1: How long have I been here? The candles on my altar went out.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.arwah.g2: You are warm... you still have a body, don't you?
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.arwah.g3: Don't drink the soup yet. First remember who waits for you.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.arwah.r0: You are young still... go home before you forget the way.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.arwah.r1: Your soul shines. The hungry ghosts can surely smell you.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.arwah.r2: An immortal... could you carry my message to heaven?
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.arwah.e: The sky above bleeds... the hungry ones crawl out of the cracks.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.wuchang_putih: One look brings fortune! Hehe, except for the dead.
My hat is tall so new souls can find me.
My lantern lights the way home, not the way out.
Brother Hei is quiet. I talk for the both of us.
Little soul! Don't be afraid, follow the lantern light.
A soul this big? Brother Hei's chain might snap pulling you, hehe.
(bows low) The Immortal needs no guide. May I walk with you?
A red moon! The gates are wide open, we work late tonight.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.wuchang_hitam: Peace under heaven. It is written on my hat, and it is my duty.
This chain binds those who run from their fate.
Do not linger. A soul's time is not counted by the sun.
It is not your time. The way home is the Return Gate.
Strong. But strength does not escape the scales.
(lowers his head) My chain is not for the Immortal.
Eclipse. The hungry dead cross too. Keep away from the riverbank.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.raja_naga.g0: The eastern currents bow to me, but not my guests. Please.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.raja_naga.g1: Once a monkey took the pillar that steadied my sea. Since then I lock my armoury.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.raja_naga.g2: The pearls of this palace are older than any dynasty on land.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.raja_naga.g3: That rebel yaksha was once my guard. Loyalty can sink too.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.raja_naga.r0: Land cultivators rarely reach my palace. Mind your manners.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.raja_naga.r1: Your soul is hard as coral. My armoury may be worthy of you.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.raja_naga.r2: A True Immortal in my hall! Set the table, open the sea wine!
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.raja_naga.e: The sky is restless; even the waves above my palace stir.
The Crystal Palace receives no guest who brings anger.
This door holds back the sea. Close it behind you.
The Dragon King is receiving. Speak only what you need.
My trident has never lost a fish... or a thief.
You are still shallow for this sea. Be careful out there.
Welcome, guest. The King waits for such as you.
(bows) The palace doors open for the Immortal.
The sky is strange today. Even the fish are hiding.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pertapa.g0: Waves come, waves go. So does breath.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pertapa.g1: I came to this island for one breath. That was thirty years ago.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pertapa.g2: Silence is deeper than the sea.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pertapa.g3: The bamboo that bends does not break in the storm.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pertapa.r0: The roots of your Dao are young. Water them with patience.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pertapa.r1: Seen the end of your road? No? Good. Keep walking.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pertapa.r2: Immortal... what do you seek on an old hermit's island?
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pertapa.e: Look at the sky. Even heaven has moods.
Penglai floats because nothing binds it.
The peaches here ripen every three thousand years. I have eaten only two.
Five immortal mountains once rode on turtles. Few remain.
This spring clarifies, it does not strengthen. The difference matters.
Your road is still at the mountain's foot. Penglai will not run away.
Dao Union... you begin to hear the same voice I hear.
Fellow Immortal, sit. Let us watch the waves together.
The sky changes, the sea follows. This island stays calm.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pedagang.g0: Spirit shells, sea salt, smoked fish! Fair prices for cultivators!
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pedagang.g1: Spirit stones, not stolen pearls. This stall is honest.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pedagang.g2: A sect ship stopped by yesterday. Bought every salted fish I had.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pedagang.g3: Don't trade on the reef isles; the yaksha there give no change.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pedagang.r0: Young cultivator! A guiding pearl for you, cheap.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pedagang.r1: Honoured cultivator, the best goods for you.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pedagang.r2: (bows) The Immortal shops at my stall? My stall is blessed!
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.pedagang.e: Strange sky, few buyers. Come, shop before the storm!
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.nelayan.g0: This sea has no end, but the net always comes back full.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.nelayan.g1: Penyu Ao swam by last night. Its wake reached my jetty.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.nelayan.g2: Want to know where the isles lie? Ask. This old man has seen them all.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.nelayan.g3: Don't swim near the old reef. The crabs are as big as boats.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.nelayan.r0: Youngster, don't stray far from the jetty before you are strong.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.nelayan.r1: You can fight the high-tier sea monsters? Impressive.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.nelayan.r2: (bows) An Immortal on my rickety jetty... my lucky day.
kultivator.dimensi.celoteh.nelayan.e: Look at that sky! The fish rise to the surface when it's like this.
kultivator.dimensi.gerhana.bawah: The sky of the world above bleeds: the ghost gates stand wide and the hungry dead gather thicker.
kultivator.dimensi.gerhana.bawah_usai: The eclipse above has ended; the ghost gates narrow again.
kultivator.dimensi.langit_laut.meteor_sh: Stars fall over the eastern sea. The fishermen count their wishes.
The rain of stars over the sea has passed.
kultivator.dimensi.langit_laut.blood_ecl: The sea's horizon turns red: a blood eclipse in the world above.
kultivator.dimensi.langit_laut.twin_moon: Two moons pull the spirit tide: it rises, and the herb beds of the isles bear double.
kultivator.dimensi.herba.petik_pasang: The twin moons' spirit tide: %s and one more picked.
kultivator.dimensi.mengpo.teknik_kembali: You forget %s; its %s mastery points dissolve into insight of %s (+%s comprehension).
kultivator.dimensi.ui.court.karma.deeds: Deeds in the wide world: %s of %s (%s).
kultivator.dimensi.ui.court.karma.no_dee: Deeds in the wide world: none written yet.
kultivator.dimensi.ui.court.karma.hancur: Mode Kehancuran: on; your last %s casts broke %s blocks.
Mode Kehancuran: off (%s casts on record).
kultivator.dimensi.ui.king.armory.title: Armoury of the Crystal Palace
kultivator.dimensi.ui.king.armory.intro: Behind a curtain of pearls stand sea-forged weapons: water element, forged by the palace smiths in Ao Guang's name.
kultivator.dimensi.ui.king.armory.honour: As an honoured guest, the Immortal-grade rack is open to you.
kultivator.dimensi.ui.king.armory.guest: The Immortal-grade rack is for honoured guests only: finish both of the Dragon King's errands.
kultivator.dimensi.raja_naga.senjata_bel: The Crystal Palace armoury hands you %s.
kultivator.dimensi.raja_naga.senjata_tut: This weapon is for the palace's honoured guests: finish both of the Dragon King's errands.

kultivator.dimensi.nelayan.kabar.pertapa: 'The nearest Hermit Isle lies to the %s, about %s blocks. I marked it on your map.'
kultivator.dimensi.nelayan.kabar.pasar: 'The nearest Market Isle lies to the %s, about %s blocks. I marked it on your map.'
kultivator.dimensi.nelayan.kabar.karang: 'The nearest Reef Isle lies to the %s, about %s blocks. I marked it on your map.'
kultivator.dimensi.nelayan.kabar.istana: 'The nearest Dragon Palace lies to the %s, about %s blocks. I marked it on your map.'
kultivator.dimensi.nelayan.kabar.penglai: 'The nearest Penglai Isle lies to the %s, about %s blocks. I marked it on your map.'
kultivator.dimensi.nelayan.penyu: 'Last I saw Penyu Ao it swam to the %s, about %s blocks. Stand on its back if you dare.'
kultivator.dimensi.nelayan.penyu_tiada: 'Penyu Ao is nowhere in these waters right now.'
kultivator.dimensi.nelayan.tiada: The fisherman shakes his head: no %s within his sailing range.
kultivator.dimensi.nelayan.tunggu: The fisherman is still remembering... ask again in %s seconds.
kultivator.dimensi.pulau.tiba: You set foot on a %s (%s of %s kinds of spirit isle).
kultivator.dimensi.ui.fisher.title: The Old Fisherman of the Jetty
kultivator.dimensi.ui.fisher.intro: Old Lao mends his net, eyes on the horizon. 'Where to, youngster? I know this sea like the palm of my hand.'
kultivator.dimensi.ui.fisher.seen: Kinds of spirit isle you have set foot on: %s of %s.
kultivator.dimensi.ui.fisher.wait: His memory needs time: %s more seconds.
kultivator.dimensi.ui.fisher.ready: Choose the place you want to know; it will be marked on your map.
kultivator.dimensi.ui.fisher.sky.1: 'Stars falling tonight. The fish rise to watch.'
kultivator.dimensi.ui.fisher.sky.2: 'A red sky in the world above. The sea is uneasy; don't go far.'
kultivator.dimensi.ui.fisher.sky.3: 'Two moons! The spirit tide is high; herb beds bear double.'
kultivator.dimensi.ui.wuchang.putih.gree: A white hat as tall as a tower bows to you. 'Welcome, little soul! Fear not, I am your guide.'
Bai Wuchang grins, his red tongue lolling. 'Such a great soul! Come, let me show you the way.'
Bai Wuchang bows until his hat touches the ground. 'The Immortal needs no guide, but this lantern is yours.'
kultivator.dimensi.ui.wuchang.hitam.gree: Hei Wuchang stares at you a long while, his chain clinking. 'Walk straight. Do not look at the river.'
Hei Wuchang nods once. 'Strong. Your scales still wait.'
Hei Wuchang lowers his head and his chain. 'This chain is not for the Immortal.'
kultivator.dimensi.ui.wuchang.putih.part: 'One look brings fortune! May your road be light.'
kultivator.dimensi.ui.wuchang.soul: About %s minutes of soul time remain.
kultivator.dimensi.ui.wuchang.not_soul: You are not walking as a soul; here you are only a guest.
kultivator.dimensi.ui.wuchang.mengpo_not: you have not met Meng Po yet
kultivator.dimensi.ui.wuchang.next.mengp: Meng Po's pavilion at the end of the Naihe bridge
kultivator.dimensi.ui.wuchang.next.yama: Yanluo's palace, where the Book of Life and Death lies
kultivator.dimensi.ui.wuchang.way_unknow: Next: %s. Its road cannot be seen from here; follow the lantern road.
kultivator.dimensi.ui.wuchang.eclipse: A blood eclipse above: the gates stand open and the hungry dead are many. Walk under the lanterns.
kultivator.dimensi.ui.wuchang.btn.go: Thank you, I am on my way
kultivator.dimensi.voice.court_pass: You have passed this court. Go on.
kultivator.dimensi.voice.yama_book: Open the book. Your name is in it.

advancement.kultivator.dunia.court_mirro: Pass the first court and see your deeds in the Karma Mirror.
advancement.kultivator.dunia.letter_deli: Deliver a ghost's letter to the living.
advancement.kultivator.dunia.lost_soul_h: Escort a lost soul across the Naihe bridge.
advancement.kultivator.dunia.name_struck: As a True Immortal, strike your name from the Book of Life and Death.
advancement.kultivator.dunia.pearl_retur: Return the pearl the sea serpent stole to the Dragon King.
advancement.kultivator.dunia.penglai_wat: Drink the Water of the Penglai Spring and receive deep insight.
advancement.kultivator.dunia.islands_all: Set foot on all four kinds of spirit isle: Herb, Hermit, Market and Reef.
advancement.kultivator.dunia.turtle_ride: Stand on the island Penyu Ao carries.
